baseline_plan.title: Raised soft resting place for fragile object
baseline_plan.summary: Use a book stack to raise a blanket on the office chair seat, creating a soft, elevated surface for the small fragile object.

steps.action: Place the stack of books flat on the seat of the office chair.
steps.why_it_helps: Creates a raised platform above the chair seat.

steps.action: Unfold and lay the blanket over the book stack, smoothing it to form a soft surface.
steps.why_it_helps: Provides a soft layer so the fragile object does not contact the hard books.

steps.action: Gently place the small fragile object onto the center of the blanket.
steps.why_it_helps: Positions the object on the soft, raised resting place.

assumptions: The book stack is stable and can support the weight of the blanket and object.
The blanket is thick enough to provide a soft surface.
unresolved_risks: The blanket may shift or slide on the books, potentially causing the object to move.
The object may roll off if the blanket surface is not level.
constraint_check: Budget: $0 – no purchases or costs involved.
Only listed inventory objects used (office_chair_01, books_01, blanket_01).
Small fragile object is treated as an explicit external resource.
Object rests on soft blanket layer, not directly on books.
Resting place is raised above chair seat by the book stack.
No adhesives, tape, clamps, fasteners, stands, or unlisted materials used.
No permanent modifications made to any object.
No damage claimed or inflicted on listed objects.
No claims of non-slip, waterproof, impact-proof, locked, or guaranteed stability.
